cmd: which python python3 node npm 2>/dev/null; ls /usr/bin | grep -iE 'python|node' ; echo "---"; apt list --installed 2>/dev/null | grep -i python | head
cat /etc/os-release 2>/dev/null | head -3; which apt-get apk yum dnf 2>/dev/null
apt-get update -qq 2>&1 | tail -2 && DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y -qq python3 2>&1 | tail -3

cd /app && python3 << 'EOF'
octet = r'(?:25[0-5]|2[0-4][0-9]|1[0-9][0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|[0-9])'
ip = r'(?<![a-zA-Z0-9])(?:' + octet + r'\.){3}' + octet + r'(?![a-zA-Z0-9])'
feb   = r'02-(?:0[1-9]|1[0-9]|2[0-9])'                            # Feb: 01-29
other = r'(?:0[13456789]|1[0-2])-(?:0[1-9]|1[0-9]|2[0-9]|3[01])'  # other months: 01-31
date  = r'\d{4}-(?:' + feb + '|' + other + r')'
date_b = r'(?<![a-zA-Z0-9])' + date + r'(?![a-zA-Z0-9])'
pattern = r'^(?=.*' + ip + r').*(?<![a-zA-Z0-9])(' + date + r')(?![a-zA-Z0-9])(?!.*' + date_b + r')'
print(pattern)
print('length:', len(pattern))
with open('/app/regex.txt','w') as f:
    f.write(pattern)
import re
re.compile(pattern)
print('compiles OK')
EOF
